name: bs-tax-overview
description: Overview of the Bahamas tax system for 2026. No personal income tax, no corporate income tax, no capital gains, inheritance or gift tax. What exists is VAT (10% standard, 5% medical goods, unprepared food from food stores exempt from 1 April 2026), the business licence tax on turnover, National Insurance (NIB) contributions, real property tax, VAT on property conveyances, stamp duty on some instruments, customs duties and the Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax for large multinational groups. Gives the headline 2026 figures and which skill to load. Trigger on Bahamas tax system, taxes in the Bahamas, is the Bahamas tax free, moving to the Bahamas tax. Built from Bahamian legislation and DIR pages; not reviewed by an accountant.
